FAULT IN THE QUESTION, not only the script. Nothing in the passage evidences the key 'being worried and in a hurry': lines 48-49 give only 'the agitation and half darkness', the preamble says they arrived late 'tired and hungry', and lines 53-54 only that supper was missed. No line shows worry or hurry. The draft fills the gap by invention: 'On a first night in a strange house, the family was worried and rushed about.' is claimed of the passage and is not in it. The key needs rewording to something the text supports (e.g. the upset and bustle of arriving late at night) before any script can be approved.

'Read line 29 and find the words 'growing out of the top'' - the phrase runs across two lines: line 29 ends 'growing out of', 'the top' is on line 30. Cite lines 29 and 30 (or quote only 'growing out of' for line 29). Otherwise the round-1 quotation-mark fault is fixed and the reasoning is sound.
